title: Blind Chess (Banqi)
win: Capture all opponent's face-up pieces (opponent with no legal moves loses)
special: Chinese hidden-piece game (Banqi, 暗棋) played on a 4×8 board (half a Xiangqi board). All 32 pieces placed face-down randomly. Each turn: flip a piece, move a piece, or capture. Piece ranks are unknown until revealed. Capture hierarchy: General defeats all except Soldier; Soldier defeats General. Cannon captures by jumping over exactly one screen (Taiwanese rules).
